conventions.invalid_citation: Secondary dimensions assess authenticated evidence only, not the supplied text. A cited span that cannot be authenticated gives span_completeness unresolved; missing evidence alone gives contrary_evidence none; support is unsupported.
conventions.pixel_estimate: A claim that unscaled pixels establish a physical value is treated as a contradicted measurement-method claim when the selected note says the drawing is not to scale.
